drawer_games_text: One-tap arcade games built for quick sessions and real skill. Easy to learn, hard to put down.

fl_home_text: Two cars, one mind. Steer both at once, one with each thumb. Catch every glowing light, dodge every red shard, and keep both lanes alive as the speed climbs.
fl_point1: One tap per car: left half, right half.
fl_point2: Chain late dodges to multiply your score.
hw_home_text: Run several timers at once and see where your day actually goes. A living background, a small pet for company, and no ads or tracking.
how_title: Three rules on the workshop wall.
rule1_text: One clear idea per product, polished until it feels right in the hand.
rule2_text: No accounts to play, offline where it makes sense, and ads you can switch off. No tricks.
rule3_text: We design, build and support everything we ship ourselves, so there is always someone to answer.

studio_desc: About The Happy Smash Iron, an independent studio making small mobile games and handy apps.
studio_p1: The Happy Smash Iron is an independent studio. We make small mobile games and handy apps, the kind you can learn in a few seconds and keep coming back to.
studio_p2: The name says how we like to work: pick one good idea, put it on the anvil and keep hammering until it feels right. Then we smile, ship it, and start on the next one.
studio_p3: We keep things fair. Our games play offline, need no account, and treat ads as something you can switch off, not something to trap you with.
glance_bench_note: Both coming soon to Google Play

fl_desc: Flicklane: two cars, one mind. A fast one-tap reflex arcade game for Android.
fl_lead: Two cars, one mind. Tap the left or right half of the screen to switch each car’s lane. Catch every light, dodge every red shard, and keep both cars alive as the speed climbs.
fl_feature_alt: Flicklane: two neon cars on a dark two-lane road
facts_title: Simple to learn, hard to put down.
fact1_text: Pick up and play in seconds.
fact2_text: Late dodges and synced catches multiply your score.
fact3_text: No account, no internet needed to play.
fact4_text: Optional one-time ad removal; continue a run with a video or with lights you earn by playing.

help_text: Tell us about it. We read every message.
hw_desc: Hourwell: run several timers at once. A calm, ad-free time tracker for Android with a living background and no tracking.
hw_lead: Run several timers at once and see where your day actually goes. A calm, ad-free time tracker with a living background and a small pet that keeps you company.
hw_feature_alt: Hourwell: an hourglass icon over a desert oasis at night, with the line Calm time tracking with many timers at once
shot1_alt: Home screen with two timers running side by side
shot2_alt: Statistics: a weekly bar chart of tracked time
shot3_alt: Summaries with a streak counter and a 12-week heatmap
shot5_alt: An activity with a daily goal, a limit and a Pomodoro length
shot6_alt: Settings for data and privacy: no ads, no tracking
hw_facts_title: Calm on the outside, precise underneath.
hwf1_text: Study, work, exercise, reading: each keeps its own colour and emoji, and keeps running while the screen is locked.
hwf2_text: Five living themes, from a desert oasis to a bubbling lab, and a small pet that naps while your timer runs.
hwf3_text: Set a daily goal or limit per activity, and a Pomodoro length that chimes when the time is up.
hwf4_text: Day, week and month views, bar and pie charts, a streak counter and a heatmap of the last 12 weeks.
hwf5_text: No ads, no tracking, no account. Records stay on your phone; export to CSV or sync through a cloud folder you choose.
hwf6_text: A home screen widget, a quick settings tile, a daily reminder, light and dark themes, and 24 languages.
plans_title: Free for real. Pro if you want more.

plan_pro_3: Weekly and monthly goals, insights and the heatmap
